people.imagined: Laughing before the joke has even arrived, rowing the lighter side while his one-handed uncle pulls the heavier.
people.subject: The moment: in a drifting boat on a pond at morning, he laughs aloud before the punchline and grins at the viewer, while his uncle's single hand pulls the heavier oar at the frame edge. Face: a wide, cheerful, freckled round face; big bright eyes; thick messy brows; a gap-toothed mouth wide open in a laugh, a missing front tooth and freckles across his nose. Hair: black, short and spiky, a loose thread of ochre ribbon tangled in it. Body: stocky, small and bouncy, a round belly shaking with his laughter. Clothing: the robe of an outer disciple of Lạc Hà Các, simple graceful pale-ochre silk with two crossed collars, the sleeves rolled and wet at the cuffs, a thin sunset-gold border of flying geese embroidered at the hem, a loose thread hanging from one sleeve, a plain cord sash with a small jade bead. Hands and objects: both hands on a long oar, its wet blade dripping drops that glitter like sparks. Background: a misty pond ringed with reeds, pale gold haze, a flock of ducks, a second oar and a man's sleeve at the edge. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left, a warm rim of morning glow in the mist, sparkles of water on the oar. Power: a few faint motes of ochre-gold earth light drift near his shoulders, barely there. Expression: merry, lazy, loud; he truly does not mind.

people.imagined: On the reed harbour in the evening, shins scarred by reeds, planning the day she rows her great-grandfather to the Evening Isle.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a small reed boat at dusk on a reed harbour, she gives a level boatwoman's steady look at the viewer, already marking the exact stroke that will take her great-grandfather to the Evening Isle, her eyes going out to the grey sea. Face: a calm, brown, open face; steady dark-grey eyes; straight brows; a straight strong nose; a small firm mouth; fine wind lines, salt dried at her temples. Hair: black, in a thick braid wound around her head and fixed with a plain silver pin. Body: strong, lean, long-armed, feet braced so the boat does not rock. Clothing: the pale-ochre silk robe of an outer disciple of Lạc Hà Các, with two crossed collars edged in sunset-gold geese, the hem tied up high to show reed-cut shins marked with many thin white scars, clearly visible; a sea-grey gauze cloak of layered reed-green silk over the shoulders, a black sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands hold a long oar; a coil of new pale-yellow rope lies at her feet. Background: a misty reed harbour in the afterglow, gold and brown reeds, one lamp shining, a pale sea beyond. Light: low red-gold light from the upper left, silver mist and a thin rim glow on her cheek. Power: a soft blue-grey shimmer of water qi curls around her oar. Expression: a steady, level gaze, lips lightly closed, shoulders loose and still.

people.imagined: A runner stopping on a road, calves hard, lips split by wind, a message in her hand for the Watch.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy road she halts mid-run and looks at the viewer, panting, having reached the post with only a breath to speak before she must run back. Face: a lean, windburnt, brown face; bright dark eyes; straight brows; a short nose; the lower lip cracked and split with red, her nose peeling. Hair: black, in a tight single braid tied with a dusk-violet ribbon, a few strands whipped loose. Body: lean, wiry and athletic, calves hard and ridged, breath coming in gusts. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times at the neck, wide sleeves tied back above the elbow for the run, a rust-and-gold embroidered hem of flying geese lifted above the knee and spattered with dust, a strap crossing her chest to hold the tube, soft sandals laced up the shin. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small bamboo message tube sealed with red wax and tied with a cord; the left is pressed flat to her ribs. Background: a dusty steppe road bending toward a small grey watch house under a pale gold sky. Light: bright hard light from the upper left softened by drifting dust that glows like gold mist. Power: faint trails of brown-gold earth motes stream behind her heels. Expression: wide, wary eyes sweeping the road behind the viewer, lips parted and cracked, jaw tight with the duty she carries.

people.imagined: At night on a river wall, looking over the dark water at Thính Vũ's lamps with clean scholar's hands folded behind him and a smile held a little too long.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a river wall he turns and smiles slowly at the viewer, the smile held too long, because he knows a skiff is out on the dark water. Face: a handsome, cold, narrow face; pale clean skin; a scar through the left eyebrow, clearly visible; cool dark eyes; a straight nose; thin lips in a lingering smile with even, very white teeth. Hair: black, in a high knot with a silver pin shaped like a fish. Body: tall, lean and very still, one hip against the wall, relaxed like a cat; narrow wrists, long clean fingers with nails pared square. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các, flowing rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, a long sea-grey gauze over-coat with embroidered silver-gold geese along its spotless cuffs, a silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: the white clean scholar's hands folded in front of the belt, a thin white jade ring on the left forefinger; past the left shoulder rises the tan-corded hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword slung on the back, its ochre-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of plain grey steel. Background: black water with tiny distant yellow lamp lights and drifting mist. Light: cold silver moonlight from the upper left rimming his profile and the scar, a pale glow in the mist. Power: a thin shimmer of blue-grey water qi hangs about his shoulders. Expression: cold, arrogant, pleased with the night.

people.imagined: A fisher boy at the outer gate, bird-thin chest swelling, startling everyone with a deep clear note.
people.subject: The moment: a fisher boy at the outer gate at dusk, mid-song, his chest swelling and his mouth wide open, looks at the viewer with surprise at his own voice as the first full note rings across the yard and everyone turns to stare. Face: a thin, brown, open face with wide dark eyes, thin brows, sun freckles, large ears and a mouth open on a clear note, collarbones showing above the collar. Hair: black, short and untidy, cropped by a fisherman's knife and longer on one side. Body: bird-thin chest and narrow shoulders, ribs rising under the robe as he breathes in. Clothing: the pale-ochre silk robe of an outer disciple of Lạc Hà Các, a little loose, with two crossed collars, the long sleeves rolled twice, sunset-gold geese embroidered along the border and a stern-lamp clasp of brass at the collar. Hands and objects: one hand spread flat over his breastbone and the other held out palm up, as if offering the note. Background: a wooden outer-gate yard with a row of washed lamps hanging on a rail, a pale orange dusk sky with soft mist. Light: warm low dusk light from the upper left and a gentle rim glow. Power: a faint blue-grey shimmer of water qi ripples out from his throat like rings on a pond. Expression: startled, sweet and trusting, the eyes round, the whole thin face given over to the note.

people.imagined: Drilling with the cadets she was not invited to, biting her lower lip until it scabs, after breaking a boy's wrist and not stopping.
people.subject: The moment: in a drill rank at pale noon, she grits her teeth and bites her lower lip, glaring ahead and sidelong at the viewer; she has just broken a boy's wrist and kept drilling. Face: a hard, thin, sharp young face; dark intense eyes; heavy straight brows; a scabbed lower lip, bitten raw and crusted, clearly visible; a tiny scar in her left eyebrow. Hair: black, in a tight high braid pinned with a silver hairpin, a few short hairs stuck to her damp forehead. Body: slim, rigid and strong, fists tight and heels dug in. Clothing: the pale-ochre silk robe of an outer disciple of Lạc Hà Các, tightly belted so the cloth puckers, two crossed collars with a thin sunset-gold border of geese, a grey goose-feather pin at the collar, a faint rust-red smear from her lip on one wide sleeve. Hands and objects: both hands grip a plain ash drill spear with a brass cap, knuckles white; slung across her back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a short slim sword with a rounded practice tip, its grip bound in pale-ochre hemp tape gone dark where her palm sits, a plain round iron guard, a scabbard of scuffed madder-brown leather whose cord loop was mended with rust-red thread. Background: a dusty drill ground with ranks of small figures and a boy holding a splinted wrist, softened into pale gold haze. Light: hard pale spirit-light from above left with a cold rim glow along her jaw. Power: a thin grey-gold glint of metal qi edges the spear tip. Expression: a fierce glare, chin low, eyes hard, not a trace of regret.

people.imagined: In the old seat's kitchen at midwinter, flour in her eyebrows, a jar of pebbles in her hand for the thick end of the pot, daring anyone to laugh.
people.subject: The moment: in a steaming kitchen at midwinter she holds up a jar and a ladle and glares at the viewer, daring anyone to laugh, the lots drawn for the thick end of the pot and a boy having laughed at her bun. Face (most important: a shiny pink burn scar on one cheek, plainly visible, and flour-white eyebrows): a broad, round, red face shiny with steam, small sharp eyes, a stubborn jaw and a doubling chin. Hair: grey, in a tight bun under a clean white cloth with a streak of flour across it. Body: broad, short and strong-armed, standing with hands on her hips and feet planted. Clothing: a servant's robe of the Lạc Hà Các kitchens, plain but clean, rust cloth with a soft sunset-gold gauze over-sleeve rolled to the elbow, the cuffs dusted with flour, one modest goose embroidered at the collar, a pale apron-sash tied over it. Hands and objects: one hand holds a big wooden ladle; the other a glass jar of small white pebbles. Background: a kitchen filled with drifting steam, a huge black iron pot glowing on the stove, ladles hanging in rows, all in amber mist. Light: warm firelight from the lower left, steam lit gold like spirit-mist, a soft rim of orange on her cheek. Power: a faint orange glow of fire qi dances in the steam above the pot. Expression: a stern glare, chin lifted, mouth set, generous and stubborn, a dare rather than a threat.

people.imagined: In a small boat at the edge of an evening isle, with a bald brown head and eyes the colour of river water. He has rowed more dying elders than anyone but one.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in a small boat at the edge of an evening isle with the oars at rest, he gazes calmly at the viewer, having rowed more dying elders than anyone but one. Face: a lined, brown, bald head; eyes a pale water-grey-green, strikingly light in a dark face; sparse white eyebrows; a thin calm mouth; ears that stick out and a spotted scalp. Hair: none, with a few white whiskers. Body: lean, long-limbed and worn, long arms hanging loosely between his knees, bare feet braced on the bottom boards. Clothing: a clean faded pale-ochre silk robe of Lạc Hà Các, soft with age, two crossed collars and a worn sunset-gold border of geese, a reed rain cape across the shoulders bound with twisted grass cord, a plain sea-grey sash. Hands and objects: both gnarled brown hands rest on oars black with age and polished pale at the grips; a coil of wet grey rope lies at his heel. Background: still dark evening water under silver mist, a low isle with a single pale tree and one faint lantern. Light: soft red-gold evening glow from the upper left skimming the water and lighting the dome of his head, a pale spirit-light in the mist. Power: slow blue-grey wisps of water qi rise from the water around the boat like breath. Expression: pale, calm river-coloured eyes under heavy lids, a slack patient mouth, a long still gaze that seems to look past the viewer.

people.imagined: Panning a river for silver flakes on a rest day, wet hands glittering, hiding a small pouch.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a river edge, she lifts wet hands that glitter with silver and glances nervously at the viewer; she has found a fleck and is checking who saw. Face: a small, round, damp face; sharp dark eyes; arched brows; a small tight mouth with a faint greedy glint; chapped cheeks, thin eyebrows. Hair: black, in two tight braids tied with scraps of green silk thread, wet strands clinging to her cheeks. Body: small and wiry, knees in wet pebbles. Clothing: the pale-ochre silk robe of an outer disciple of Lạc Hà Các, two crossed collars, a sunset-gold goose border, sleeves rolled and wet at the cuffs, a small cloth pouch of dusk-violet silk tied at the waist with three knots and bulging. Hands and objects: both wet palms sparkle with a dozen fine silver flakes like tiny fish scales, clearly visible; a shallow wooden pan rests in the water before her. Background: a shallow stony river running bright, ripples of light, pale mist over the far bank. Light: bright spirit-light on the water from the upper left throwing moving ripples of glow across her face. Power: a few green motes of wood qi gather around her fingers, faint. Expression: a nervous sidelong glance, head turned a little away, lips pressed tight, eyes bright with greed while her fingers close over the flake.

people.imagined: At the outer gate stifling a yawn badly, with a new silver ring she should not have, thinking of a stall.
people.subject: The moment: stifling a big yawn behind her hand during a long lecture, she eyes the viewer sleepily, a new silver ring flashing on the other hand, thinking of a stall. Face: a pretty, soft, round face with light brown skin, heavy-lidded slightly puffy eyes, full lips parted in the yawn. Hair: black, loose in a long half-tail, a bright pink ribbon tied in a loose bow, a few strands across her eyes. Body: soft, relaxed, slouching against a pillar. Clothing: the pale-ochre silk robe of an outer disciple of Lạc Hà Các in fine gauze, the wide sleeves hanging loose, two crossed collars with sunset-gold geese, a bright pink silk sash tied in a bow with a tassel and a little jade bead. Hands and objects: the left hand over her mouth; on the right middle finger a thin, plain, bright silver ring with a small smooth flat top, clearly visible. Background: an outer-gate yard dissolving into drifting gold afternoon haze, a bench, a pillar and an empty bowl. Light: warm sleepy afternoon light slanting through a gap from the upper left, dust motes glowing like spirit-light. Power: a few faint brown-green motes drift lazily by her sleeve. Expression: sleepy and bored with a glint of cunning behind it, eyelids low, the mind plainly elsewhere, a practical girl working out what a stall could earn.

people.imagined: On the drill field, head cocked to listen as his father does, a good cadet who fears what his father wants.
people.subject: The moment: on the drill field at cool dawn, he cocks his head to listen and looks sideways at the viewer with a worried frown, a good cadet who fears what his father wants, his father's voice dropping quiet down the field. Face: a long, earnest, handsome young face with steady grey-brown eyes, straight brows, a straight nose, a worried mouth and a muscle tightening in the jaw. Hair: black, in a topknot tied so flat it seems drawn on his head, held by a plain silver pin, not a hair loose. Body: tall, straight-backed and lean, stance perfect. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các, fine rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed in three folds, wide sleeves, a sunset-gold embroidered border of flying geese, closed at the neck by a tiny grey goose-feather pin, a sash with a small white jade pendant. Hands and objects: one hand holds a plain ash drill spear with a bright iron tip upright; the other lightly touches his ear with long still fingers; a plain slim jian with a round guard in an ochre-brown scabbard is slung diagonally across his back, its dull bronze guard and the grip wrapped in tan cord showing above the right shoulder. Background: a long drill field in drifting grey-gold mist, rows of cadets in rust robes. Light: cool even dawn spirit-light with a pale rim along his cheek. Power: a faint grey-brown shimmer of earth qi settles around his shoulders. Expression: worried, cautious under perfect discipline, brows drawn and mouth tight, a peaceable young man listening for what his father is not saying.

people.imagined: Carrying a lit stern lamp up the river path, oil on her sleeves, not blinking at the flame.
people.subject: The moment: carrying a lit round stern lantern in both hands at her chest up the river path at dusk, she stares at the viewer without blinking, having carried her lamp when the village lit its lamps. Face: a round, solemn, pale face with wide unblinking dark eyes holding the flame's reflection, thin brows, long lashes catching the light and a small closed mouth. Hair: black, in a plain bun with a red thread wound twice through it, the ends trailing down her neck. Body: small and slender, standing very still with elbows tucked in. Clothing: the pale-ochre silk robe of an outer disciple of Lạc Hà Các, a little small for her, with two crossed collars, both sleeves darkened with lamp oil to the elbow, the hem damp from the river, a gold-embroidered goose border and a stern-lamp clasp at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands hold a round orange stern lamp with a steady flame, clearly lit. Background: a river path at dusk, dark reeds, one distant lit window, a dark bank under deep blue mist. Light: warm orange lamp light on her face from below, lighting the underside of her chin and lashes gold, with deep blue dusk behind. Power: a soft green shimmer of wood qi curls around the flame like a fine thread. Expression: devout, steady and unblinking, mouth closed, eyes fixed on the flame, a humble girl who believes the light is hers to carry.

people.imagined: Copying a contract in the Hall of Scales with a pencil behind one ear, a jade comb in her hair she should not have, thumb pads ink-grey.
people.subject: The moment: at a copying desk in the Hall of Scales she looks up from a sheet and tilts her head, a pencil behind her ear, a clause altered and the next about to be written. Face: a thin, pale, composed face with clever narrow grey-brown eyes, thin straight brows, a neat small mouth, a faint dimple on one cheek and a reserved look. Hair: black, in a low coil with a green jade comb, clearly visible. Body: slim and upright, sitting with perfect posture, narrow shoulders and a long neck. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các, rust silk with a plain dusk-violet collar crossed three times, wide sleeves tied back with grey cord, a thin gold border of flying geese, a sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: a thin charcoal pencil behind one ear; both thumb pads ink-grey; a brush held over a sheet of neat tiny rows of small marks, no characters; her left hand rests on a small box of jade combs, two showing green, a second sheet weighted with a stone. Background: wooden desks with neat piles of paper and tall shelves of scrolls fading into gold-grey mist. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left falling on the paper, a soft rim glow on her cheek. Power: a faint grey-brown shimmer of earth qi lies over the page. Expression: composed and secretive, eyes level, a flicker of private cunning at the corner of the mouth, a precise young woman who keeps her own copy of everything.

people.imagined: At the forge, going still because steel is near. He has felt a sword hum and told no one.
people.subject: The moment: standing frozen beside a rack of steel in the forge with his head turned toward a sword just out of frame, then toward the viewer with wide eyes; a blade has hummed on the rack, as it has before, and he has told no one. Face: a lean, soot-smudged, honest face with wide dark eyes, thick brows, a short nose, a slightly open mouth and a smear of soot across the forehead. Hair: black and short, singed at the front and standing up in tufts. Body: thin and wiry with lean, corded, forge-hardened forearms. Clothing: the pale-ochre silk robe of a Lạc Hà Các forge hand, clean, two crossed collars, sleeves rolled up and a sunset-gold goose border, a rust sash tied in two turns over a short protective smock of dark rust cloth, a little too big for him. Hands and objects: both hands held very still at his sides; at the edge of the frame a long sword in a plain scabbard lies on the rack, its guard catching a thread of blue-white light. Background: a forge glowing orange in drifting smoke and gold sparks, a rack of swords catching the light. Light: orange forge light from the lower left on one side and a thin cold blue-white spirit-gleam from the rack on the other. Power: faint silver-white motes of metal qi tremble in the air toward the blade, and red sparks of fire qi stay near his hands. Expression: honest, awed and trusting, lips parted, eyes wide, the stillness of a boy who has just heard steel speak.

people.imagined: On a meditation mat in the front row, unable to sit three breaths. A mat-weave pattern is printed in her palm.
people.subject: The moment: fidgeting on a meditation mat in the front row, she holds up one palm showing a crisscross weave pattern printed in it and grins at the viewer; she has been made to sit again. Face: a lively, narrow, bright face; bright restless dark eyes; arched brows; a quick smile; a few freckles, long lashes and a tiny scar on her chin. Hair: black, in a loose high tail tied with a bit of mat-reed instead of ribbon, bobbing. Body: small and fidgety, knees jigging under the robe. Clothing: the pale-ochre silk robe of an outer disciple of Lạc Hà Các, two crossed collars, loose wide sleeves, a sunset-gold goose border, a green silk sash knotted askew. Hands and objects: the right palm raised, red, with a clearly visible crisscross woven-mat pattern imprinted on it; the left hand holds a half-woven strip of straw, its ends sticking out between her fingers. Background: a meditation hall with rows of woven mats and a high window showing pale sky, soft gold haze. Light: soft spirit-light from a high window falling in a patch on the mats and warming the side of her face. Power: tiny green motes of wood qi dart restlessly about her, a few faint ones. Expression: a bright, cheeky grin, eyes darting to one side, brows raised, shoulders already twitching to leave the mat.

people.imagined: Making pill moulds, hands stained purple to the wrist that no soap has lifted, and a quiet smile.
people.subject: The moment: holding up both purple-stained hands with a shy smile, a clay pill mould between them, after pressing a hundred moulds this week. Face: a calm, plain, round face with round cheeks, kind dark eyes, thin brows, a small smile and a purple smudge on the chin. Hair: black, in a low plain bun held by a wooden pin, wisps sticking to her damp temple. Body: stocky and steady. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, wide sleeves pushed to the elbow, a gold border of flying geese at the cuffs, a sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands and wrists stained deep purple to the wrist, clearly visible, with a faint blue sheen no soap has lifted; between them a palm-sized brown clay mould with seven round hollows in a ring, still damp. Background: a workbench of clay moulds before a shelf of jars of purple dye and bowls of fine clay powder, and a window onto a courtyard wall washed pale gold, all in soft haze. Light: warm window light from the upper left lighting the purple of her hands, with a gentle rim glow. Power: soft green-gold motes of wood and earth qi float up from the damp clay, faint. Expression: a quiet, shy, diligent smile, eyes kind, head slightly lowered, a humble woman proud of one small useful thing.

people.imagined: At his trade-office desk, rubbing the callus on his forefinger while he tells a pleasant lie to a visitor.
people.subject: The moment: behind a desk in his trade office he rubs the callus on his right forefinger with his thumb while smiling at the viewer, a cask of wine on the desk and a visitor asking about a client, telling a pleasant lie. Face: a smooth, round, pleasant face with fair skin, friendly dark eyes, thick brows, a neat small moustache, a double chin, a small mole by the nose and a practised warm smile. Hair: black, in a tidy knot held by a wooden pin with a gold cap. Body: plump, comfortable, relaxed, elbows on the desk and fingertips together. Clothing: the robe of an affairs steward of Lạc Hà Các, rust brocade silk with a crisp dusk-violet collar of excellent cloth crossed three times, wide sleeves tied back, sunset-gold geese and clouds embroidered along the borders, a deep ochre sash with a gold thread through it and a fine jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right forefinger shows a big yellow callus, clearly visible; under the left hand a tally book with a green cover and tiny marks, no characters. Background: shelves of tally books with red tags in a market office, lost in warm amber haze. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, a soft shadow under his chin and a golden glow on his cheek. Power: a faint brown-gold aura of earth qi sits calmly around him. Expression: a smooth, patient, practised warmth that does not reach the eyes, head tilted slightly as if to invite your trust.

people.imagined: At sunset in the Hall of Scales, a small dry frame filled with a rich carrying voice, reading oaths aloud with her chin lifted.
people.subject: The moment: at sunset in the Hall of Scales she reads from an open scroll with her chin lifted and her mouth open in a full ringing voice, eyes on the viewer, the sun just touching the horizon as she begins the oath. Face: a small, dry, narrow face; fair skin; steady dark eyes; strong straight brows; a wide mouth open in speech; a firm chin; a thin neck with tendons standing out as she speaks. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a single bronze pin, two stray hairs at the temple. Body: small, thin and very upright, the chest small but the breath deep. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar pressed to a crisp edge and crossed three times, sleeves tied back with brown cord, sunset-gold geese on the borders, a black cord at the cuffs, a fine jade pendant on her sash. Hands and objects: both hands hold open a long blank paper scroll with rows of faint marks and no characters, its edge curling. Background: a pillared hall with tall dark pillars, a red band of sunset in the window and gold mist. Light: low red sunset light from the upper left floods from the window and warms her cheek, a bright rim of glow. Power: a brown-gold aura of earth qi gathers around her voice, brightening in rings as she speaks. Expression: chin lifted, mouth round on the words, a clear firm gaze and a steady, unsparing set to the brows.

people.imagined: Emerging from a gallery shaft, rock dust ground into his knees and a pickaxe on his shoulder. He would bring the village up if anyone paid.
people.subject: The moment: climbing out of a shaft mouth he rests a pickaxe on his shoulder and looks at the viewer with a loyal steady stare, the sun surprising him after the dark, ready to bring the village up if anyone paid. Face: a square, dusty, brown face with steady dark eyes, thick brows grey with dust, a broad nose, a scar splitting the left eyebrow, a short beard shadow and a firm mouth. Hair: black, cropped short and turned grey by dust. Body: broad, thick-armed and strong, thick thighs, a wide stance. Clothing: the rust silk robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, with a dusk-violet collar open on a dust-streaked neck, thick rust cloth reinforcing both elbows, the knees grey-white with ground rock dust, sleeves rolled, a rope belt and a small jade pendant, gold geese on the borders dulled by dust. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a short iron pickaxe on the shoulder; on the other side a dented, blackened tin lamp hangs on a short strap. Background: a dark shaft mouth with a ladder rising from it, grey-gold mist drifting out of the earth. Light: dim warm light from the upper left, a bright slot of sky above the shaft and the soft glow of the lamp. Power: a steady silver-grey and brown aura of earth and metal qi clings to his shoulders and hands. Expression: loyal, steady and brave, mouth firm, eyes narrowed against the sun, a man who wants work for his village and will dig for it.

people.imagined: On the drill ground, a dent in her brow where a well-rope slipped, signing a petition behind her master's back with a bold stroke.
people.subject: The moment: drilling a second line, she stands hard and glares at the viewer, a dent plain in her forehead; she signed a petition behind her master's back and her hand does not shake. Face: a hard, strong, broad face; tanned skin; a deep dent in her brow above one eye, plainly visible; fierce dark eyes; heavy brows; a firm jaw, flat nose and weathered cheeks. Hair: black, tightly braided and pinned flat with two iron pins. Body: broad-shouldered, solid, upright, stance wide, fists tight. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, tight at the shoulders and belted with a square brass buckle on a dark sash, sleeves rolled, gold geese along the borders, a grey goose-feather pin at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands grip a drill spear of ash with a bright cap; a folded paper tucked in the belt shows a corner of red wax. Background: a drill ground with ranks of cadets standing in pale gold dust-mist. Light: hard bright spirit-light from the upper left on the dusty ground with a cold rim on her jaw. Power: a hard brown-gold aura of earth qi rises from her planted feet like heat. Expression: a hard, bold glare, jaw squared, the dent in her brow drawn into a frown; her gaze does not waver.

people.imagined: In the tea terraces with a wide hat tied under her chin with a purple cord, pricing a pill a tenth under a rival.
people.subject: The moment: in the tea terraces under a wide tea-grower's hat tied with a purple cord, she looks briskly at the viewer, a small pill case in hand, having priced her pill a tenth under the rival's again. Face: a round, brown, shrewd face with plump tanned cheeks, bright quick dark eyes, arched brows, a firm small mouth and a pointed chin. Hair: black, mostly hidden under the hat, a tuft escaping. Body: stocky, brisk and capable, standing square with chest out, arms strong from picking, legs planted wide. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, hitched at the hem, sleeves rolled and cuffs stained green with tea, gold geese on the borders, a purple silk sash matching the hat cord, a jade pendant; a wide round straw hat with a purple cord tied under the chin, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a small round lacquered pill box; the left a sprig of green tea. Background: terraced rows of tea bushes climbing a hillside with red maples, in drifting green-gold mist. Light: bright warm spirit-light from the upper left, green reflected on her chin. Power: a bright green-gold aura of wood qi sways around her like leaves in a breeze. Expression: brisk and ambitious, brows arched, mouth pressed in a small satisfied line, a hard-working woman who knows the price of everything.

people.imagined: At the helm of a river boat, a broken, badly set finger on the tiller, eyes on the horizon where a sea boat waits.
people.subject: The moment: at a boat tiller she looks at the viewer with an ambitious sideways glance, one finger crooked, the sea boat out there and her not on it. Face: a sharp, handsome, weathered face with olive skin, bold dark eyes, strong arched brows, a straight nose, a confident mouth and a thin white scar above the lip. Hair: black, in a high tail with a faded blue silk ribbon. Body: lean, strong and balanced, legs braced, back straight. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, open at the neck, sleeves rolled to the elbow, gold geese on the borders, and a sea-grey gauze short cloak pinned with a shining brass fish. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a smooth black wooden tiller with a carved head, the index finger bent sideways at the middle joint, badly set and swollen, clearly visible. Background: a wide pale river meeting the sea on a far horizon, mist and a gold sky. Light: bright cold river light from the upper left with a silver rim on her cheek. Power: a blue-grey aura of water qi streams along her arm into the tiller, the wake glittering. Expression: ambitious, impatient and hungry, gaze pulled toward the horizon, jaw lifted, a woman who counts every river day as a day not at sea.

people.imagined: On the steppe road with a satchel rubbed pale at the clasp, carrying a list of thirty he does not like to carry.
people.subject: The moment: on a dusty steppe road he holds a leather satchel against his chest and looks at the viewer with a loyal, uneasy stare, the list of thirty in the bag and the road still long. Face: a long, thin, plain, honest, tanned face with worried red-rimmed brown eyes, level brows, a short nose, a closed mouth, grey stubble on the jaw, tired lines below the eyes and a patient set to the mouth. Hair: black, in a plain knot with a grey strand at the temple. Body: tall and lean with the slight stoop of a man who has walked a lifetime of roads, shoulders sagging under the satchel. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, dusty to the knees, under a travelling cloak of heavy silk dusted pale and lined in dusk-violet, gold geese along its border, road-scuffed boots. Hands and objects: the satchel held in both hands, its clasp rubbed pale and shiny, clearly visible. Background: a long steppe road in dust reaching a pale horizon, a pale ribbon of road across yellow grass with a single tiny wagon, gold haze. Light: soft diffuse spirit-light from above with no hard shadows and a faint rim glow. Power: a faint brown-gold aura of earth qi hangs about him like road dust. Expression: uneasy and loyal, brows level but tight, mouth closed on what he knows, a cautious man carrying a list he does not like to carry.

people.imagined: At the edge of the grey, one grey patch on his wrist, left hand missing two fingers, a hard stare for the treasure seekers.
people.subject: The moment: at the miasma's edge he holds up his left hand with two fingers missing and looks harshly at the viewer, a captured treasure-seeker staked at the grey's edge and him checking the rope. Face: a hard, craggy, sun-black face with narrow cold eyes, heavy brows, a flat nose with a scar across the bridge, a thin cruel mouth and stubble. Hair: grey-black, cropped short, a dusty cap pushed to the back of the head. Body: broad, rough and thickset, weight on one leg. Clothing: a heavy grey padded coat of quilted silk, scorched at one cuff and repaired with leather, over the ash-grey robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times and tarnished gold geese on the border. Hands and objects: the left hand raised, only thumb, forefinger and little finger present, the two middle fingers gone and a grey ash-like stain on the wrist, clearly visible; the right hand grips a dark wooden stake sharpened at the tip. Background: grey miasma mist and drifting ash, with stakes marking the creep of the grey like a line of teeth under a leaden sky. Light: pale grey-green spirit-light from the left, a distant lantern's glow, a cold rim on his scarred nose. Power: a heavy brown-gold aura of earth qi grips the ground at his feet, pushing back the creeping grey. Expression: a pitiless, warlike stare, mouth thin and eyes cold, a loyal man who has stopped expecting mercy from anything.

people.imagined: Awake at night on a river wall counting lamps. The lamp-counters call him the Owl for his sleepless face.
people.subject: The moment: on a night river wall he stares unblinking at the viewer with wide sleepless eyes, one hand holding a knotted cord, having noticed a gap in the line of lamps where one should be; the lamp-counters call him the Owl for his sleepless face. Face: a lean, pale, owlish face with very round wide-open dark eyes under deep shadows, heavy brows, a hooked nose, hollow cheeks and a thin tight mouth. Hair: grey-black, in a tight topknot tied with black silk string. Body: thin, hunched and alert, hugging himself against the cold. Clothing: the robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, sleeves tied with black thread, gold geese on the borders, under a long sea-grey gauze coat of good silk with horn buttons. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a cord with many knots in groups of five, the last knot bright red, clearly visible; the left rests on the wall. Background: a black river with a far line of small yellow lamps scattered across the water, pale mist. Light: the cold silver light of a thin moon from the upper left, tiny lamps reflected in the black water. Power: a pale blue-grey aura of water qi shimmers faintly around him like moonlit mist. Expression: wide-eyed, worn and watchful, brows lifted, thin mouth tight, a patient, suspicious man who trusts no lamp he has not counted himself.

people.imagined: On a pitching dock, one hand on a rail, her face a faint seasick green, tallying stores and debts.
people.subject: The moment: on a pitching dock she grips a rail with one hand and looks at the viewer with a wan seasick look as a wave lifts the dock and she holds on tighter, tallying stores and debts. Face: a thin, pale face with a greenish tinge that does not leave, tired watery dark eyes, thin brows, pale lips and a thin mouth pressed tight. Hair: black, in a neat low bun held by a silver pin, a few loose hairs damp with spray. Body: frail, thin and bent slightly, knees flexed against the motion. Clothing: the robe of an affairs steward of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, gold geese on the borders, and a sea-grey gauze shawl knotted at the chest. Hands and objects: one hand clamps the wet rail, slick and green with weed; the other holds a small counting board with two rows of bone beads. Background: boats with creaking ropes on grey water, silver sea-mist. Light: dim cold spirit-light from the upper left, the water the colour of pewter, a pale rim on her cheek. Power: a faint grey aura of earth qi steadies her stance against the rolling dock. Expression: wan and queasy with a streak of impatience, lips tight, eyes narrowed, a practical woman who intends to finish the count before she is sick.

people.imagined: At the armoury bench in a smith's apron he has not taken off, arguing, wine cup near the steel.
people.subject: The moment: at the armoury bench, still in a smith's apron he has not taken off, he points a finger at the viewer in mid-argument, a smith having brought him wine and him waving a hand at the good steel. Face: a ruddy, proud, heavy face with small angry dark eyes, thick brows, a big red nose and a pouting lower lip that juts out. Hair: black, tied in a rough knot held by a bit of wire, a greasy lock hanging over the forehead. Body: stocky and thick-armed with broad shoulders, a short neck and a thick chest, the belly pushing the apron as he leans back, chin lifted, strutting. Clothing: a smith's apron of dark scorched cloth with a long burn across the belly, worn over the rust silk robe of an inner disciple of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, wine-stained, with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, gold geese on the borders, sleeves rolled. Hands and objects: the right forefinger jabs forward; on the bench beside him a cup of wine stands next to a bar of grey steel. Background: a forge glowing behind him with a rack of steel bars in drifting sparks and smoke. Light: orange light of coals from the lower left, a red gleam on his cheek and a cold silver rim on the steel. Power: a hot orange and silver-white aura of fire and metal qi flickers around his fists. Expression: proud and quarrelsome, eyes narrowed in suspicion, chin thrust out, as though everyone in the room is after his steel.

people.imagined: On the beach of the Evening Isle, a spade in sand and a sailcloth cap tied under his chin, blisters on both palms.
people.subject: The moment: on a beach lined with graves on the Evening Isle he leans on a spade facing west and looks at the viewer calmly, having dug the thirty-second grave this week and rested at its edge, a sail laid over the keeper's grave already dug. Face: a weathered, calm, brown face with a lined brow, deep creases at the mouth, deep-set quiet eyes, sparse grey brows, a long nose and a still mouth. Hair: grey, under a sailcloth cap tied with a cord under the chin, clearly visible, a few white hairs at the ears. Body: lean, long and slightly bent from digging. Clothing: a clean pale-ochre silk robe of Lạc Hà Các, plain and graceful, two crossed collars, the hem darkened with beach damp, sleeves rolled to the elbow over thin brown forearms, a sea-grey sash, a faint gold border of geese. Hands and objects: one palm turned up showing white, swollen spade blisters; the other grips the spade, its blade worn bright at the edge and its handle wrapped with strips of sailcloth. Background: low mounds in rows on the sand facing a red west, grey stones, sea-mist. Light: low red evening light from the upper left on the sand and stones, a soft spirit-glow along the shore. Power: a calm blue-grey aura of water qi lies about him like a sea fog. Expression: calm, devout and quiet, eyes steady on the setting sun, mouth at rest, a man who has made peace with the work of burying.

people.imagined: On the steppe at dusk, narrow pale eyes watching palms until full dark, writing down who lets the glow go.
people.subject: The moment: on a darkening steppe she watches a row of palms and narrows her pale eyes at the viewer, the light almost gone and one palm still glowing. Face: a thin, stern, weathered face; pale grey eyes narrowed against the sun; straight thin brows; a long nose; a tight dry mouth with thin, cracked lips. Hair: black, in one long dry braid over the shoulder, clearly visible. Body: tall, spare and rigid, standing with back straight and hands behind. Clothing: the robe of an affairs steward of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, rust silk with a dusk-violet collar crossed three times, tightly belted with a plain sash, gold geese on the borders. Hands and objects: one hand holds a small tablet and a brush; the tablet is a thin slab of wood with rows of tiny marks; at the edge of the frame a row of small open palms glows faintly gold. Background: a wide plain turning from gold to grey under drifting dusk mist. Light: the last orange light from the upper left, cool blue dusk behind, a faint rim glow. Power: a thin brown-gold aura of earth qi hangs about her, steady and cold. Expression: narrowed pale eyes, a thin even mouth, a patient cold stillness as she watches the last palm glow.

people.imagined: At the head of a caravan in a sheepskin vest over silk, jewelled left hand raised, bargaining at war prices.
people.subject: The moment: on a caravan road he raises a left hand covered in rings and grins at the viewer, selling mutton at war prices and bargaining loudly as the caravan halts at the Hạc Đinh crossing over the noise of oxen. Face: a ruddy, broad, florid face; shrewd small eyes; heavy brows; a big veined nose; a white moustache curling at the ends; heavy cheeks; a wide greedy smile. Hair: white, in a high knot with a gold hairpin. Body: stout, broad and swaggering, a big belly pushing the vest. Clothing: a sheepskin-trimmed vest of gold brocade over the rust silk robe of an affairs elder of Lạc Hà Các of Trúc Cơ standing, woven with a fine pattern of clouds, a dusk-violet crossed collar and sash, sunset-gold geese on the borders, polished boots. Hands and objects: a ring on every finger of the left hand, bronze, jade and gold, clearly visible, one with a green jade eye, one with a red stone; a coiled whip in the right. Background: a caravan of wagons and oxen in a haze of golden dust. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left, dust sparkling in the air like gold powder, a warm rim glow. Power: a rich brown-gold aura of earth qi swells around him like a merchant's pride. Expression: greedy, brave and hearty, the grin wide and a little too loud, eyes flicking to everyone's purse.
